lines.en: Nine squares. Three in a row.
Zheng Shangyou. A tiny game for a big table.
lines.zh: 争上游。给一大家子的小游戏。

lines.en: Place X or O. Block, plan, connect three.
lines.zh: 放 X 或 O。堵、算、连成三个。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to an unbeatable Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到不会输的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Zheng Shangyou. Three in a row.
